site.title: The Art of Not Art
site.intro: An evolving gallery of colour, line, form and unexpected relationships.
site.catalogueNote: Six digital collections, six works in each, £9 per collection. Titles are curatorial labels; earlier archive studies remain on view.

collections.title: Chromatic Signals
collections.subtitle: Colour, repeated and interrupted
collections.description: Saturated fields, mirrored structures and angular forms. An invitation to follow rhythm through colour.

collections.title: Geometric Play
collections.subtitle: Shapes in conversation
collections.description: Circles, planes, shaded objects and exuberant curves: six different ways to let geometry play.

collections.title: Ornamental Currents
collections.subtitle: Pattern with a pulse
collections.description: Dense marks, spirals and interlocking fields. Six intricate compositions that reward a closer look.

collections.title: Rooms of Light
collections.subtitle: Interiors, almost remembered
collections.description: Warm windows, blue corners and luminous thresholds. Six imagined spaces held between architecture and colour.

collections.title: Moon Gardens
collections.subtitle: Paths through the luminous
collections.description: Moonlit gardens, winding paths and impossible shores in deep blues, greens and golds.

collections.title: Playful Machines
collections.subtitle: Vehicles from somewhere else
collections.description: Six curious vehicles on warm paper-like grounds: a small procession of colour, character and invented engineering.

collections.title: Liquid Imaginings
collections.subtitle: Forms that almost settle
collections.description: Waves, edges and figures that suggest a world without entirely explaining it.

collections.title: Line & Rhythm
collections.subtitle: Routes through a field
collections.description: Contours, crossings and branching paths. A closer way of looking at the movement within a still image.

collections.title: A Quiet Line
collections.subtitle: Room for less
collections.description: A pause in the exhibition: one vertical form, a pale ground, and the space around them.

collections.title: An Earlier Signal
collections.subtitle: A study kept in view
collections.description: An additional work from the first archive selection, retained beside the six-image collections.

works.title: Neon cadence
works.description: A dense rhythm of acid yellow, red, cream and deep blue-black fields.
works.alt: Cream and lime bands, red accents and dark blue-black blocks repeated across a square.

works.title: Lime circuit
works.description: Black structures, bright lime and generous white interruptions.
works.alt: Mirrored black block-like structures with lime and green vertical strips against white.

works.title: Electric mosaic
works.description: Small forms gather into a vivid, repeating field.
works.alt: A square mosaic of navy shapes, cyan, yellow, magenta and white.

works.title: Cyan window
works.description: Open mint-coloured fields held in a blue and pink grid.
works.alt: Two large pale cyan fields divided by hot pink and bounded by deep blue and black.

works.title: Primary surge
works.description: Angular fragments of blue, yellow and red move across white.
works.alt: Strong blue, red and yellow angular fragments arranged on a white square.

works.title: Chromatic echo
works.description: Mirrored rainbow bars and dark forms make a concentrated centre.
works.alt: A symmetrical square composition with rainbow bars, black shapes and blue bursts.

works.title: Amber orbit
works.description: Amber panels beside curving yellow grid lines on a muted ground.
works.alt: Amber panels beside curving yellow grid lines on a muted ground.

works.title: Studies in circles
works.description: A panelled arrangement of colourful circles, rings and intersecting lines.
works.alt: A panelled arrangement of colourful circles, rings and intersecting lines.

works.title: Cabinet of forms
works.description: Shaded teal, green, coral and red forms arranged in a pale rectangular grid.
works.alt: Shaded teal, green, coral and red forms arranged in a pale rectangular grid.

works.title: Curved colour
works.description: Broad orange and cream curves surround teal and pink rounded shapes.
works.alt: Broad orange and cream curves surround teal and pink rounded shapes.

works.title: Framed flourish
works.description: A framed field of green, pink and teal curving forms with dense small marks.
works.alt: A framed field of green, pink and teal curving forms with dense small marks.

works.title: Folded planes
works.description: Overlapping dark, green, orange, purple and red geometric planes.
works.alt: Overlapping dark, green, orange, purple and red geometric planes.

works.title: Ripple centre
works.description: Golden concentric ripples and mirrored contours on a deep blue square.
works.alt: Golden concentric ripples and mirrored contours on a deep blue square.

works.title: Electric weave
works.description: Dense multicoloured lines flow into a mirrored central pattern.
works.alt: Dense multicoloured lines flow into a mirrored central pattern.

works.title: Spiral field
works.description: Bright concentric curves curl through an intricate cyan, orange and yellow field.
works.alt: Bright concentric curves curl through an intricate cyan, orange and yellow field.

works.title: Constructed current
works.description: Stacked blue, purple and orange angular bands filled with fine line patterns.
works.alt: Stacked blue, purple and orange angular bands filled with fine line patterns.

works.title: Pattern conversation
works.description: Teal, orange, yellow and pink shapes fitted together with dense linear texture.
works.alt: Teal, orange, yellow and pink shapes fitted together with dense linear texture.

works.title: Ornamental echoes
works.description: Bold red, black, cyan and yellow ornamental bands and looping forms.
works.alt: Bold red, black, cyan and yellow ornamental bands and looping forms.

works.title: Amber room
works.description: A warm amber room with three luminous windows and pale light across the floor.
works.alt: A warm amber room with three luminous windows and pale light across the floor.

works.title: Blue corner
works.description: An empty corner with luminous pale and turquoise walls above an orange floor.
works.alt: An empty corner with luminous pale and turquoise walls above an orange floor.

works.title: Pale threshold
works.description: A pale luminous oval threshold surrounded by muted red and blue.
works.alt: A pale luminous oval threshold surrounded by muted red and blue.

works.title: Green chamber
works.description: A green room with a picture, tall window and pools of light on the floor.
works.alt: A green room with a picture, tall window and pools of light on the floor.

works.title: Light on blue
works.description: A blue room with glowing windows and warm light on a red-purple floor.
works.alt: A blue room with glowing windows and warm light on a red-purple floor.

works.title: A chair in the light
works.description: A small red chair beside a tall luminous window and textured turquoise wall.
works.alt: A small red chair beside a tall luminous window and textured turquoise wall.

works.title: Moonlit path
works.description: A pale winding path between tall green forms under a bright moon in a cobalt sky.
works.alt: A pale winding path between tall green forms under a bright moon in a cobalt sky.

works.title: Between tall trees
works.description: A luminous path winds between tall red and green forms beneath a small pale moon.
works.alt: A luminous path winds between tall red and green forms beneath a small pale moon.

works.title: Blue tide
works.description: A sculpted blue wave curves around an amber form under a swirling sky.
works.alt: A sculpted blue wave curves around an amber form under a swirling sky.

works.title: Moon on water
works.description: A bright moon reflected in a yellow path across dark blue water.
works.alt: A bright moon reflected in a yellow path across dark blue water.

works.title: Golden garden
works.description: A garden path and rounded trees beneath a glowing sky, surrounded by a gold frame within the image.
works.alt: A garden path and rounded trees beneath a glowing sky, surrounded by a gold frame within the image.

works.title: Dune of light
works.description: An amber dune with a blue winding edge under a bright sun or moon in a textured sky.
works.alt: An amber dune with a blue winding edge under a bright sun or moon in a textured sky.

works.title: Green roadster
works.description: A green open-top imaginary car with patterned bodywork and blue-ringed wheels.
works.alt: A green open-top imaginary car with patterned bodywork and blue-ringed wheels.

works.title: Patterned carriage
works.description: A tall boxy carriage-like vehicle with patterned red and green panels.
works.alt: A tall boxy carriage-like vehicle with patterned red and green panels.

works.title: Orange voyager
works.description: An orange and black imaginary vehicle with an upward-curving rear.
works.alt: An orange and black imaginary vehicle with an upward-curving rear.

works.title: Scarlet traveller
works.description: A low scarlet vehicle with green doors and three pale windows, within a frame in the image.
works.alt: A low scarlet vehicle with green doors and three pale windows, within a frame in the image.

works.title: Little red car
works.description: A small red car with bright blue windows and spiral-like wheel details.
works.alt: A small red car with bright blue windows and spiral-like wheel details.

works.title: Blue wheel sketch
works.description: A spare black outline of a small car with two vivid blue wheels on a warm ground.
works.alt: A spare black outline of a small car with two vivid blue wheels on a warm ground.

works.title: Prism / passage
works.description: An angular central form appears within fields of blue, pink and pale cyan.
works.alt: A prism-like triangular form in blue, violet and yellow beside a grid of luminous colours.

works.title: Chromatic weather
works.description: Blue and green sweep around a warmer centre, within an uneven dark edge.
works.alt: A horizontal blue, green and yellow swirling field surrounded by a dark rectangular edge.

works.title: Molten edge
works.description: A yellow channel moves through red and blue, with rippling edges.
works.alt: A vertical yellow flowing shape with red and dark scalloped edges on a blue horizontal field.

works.title: An unlikely animal
works.description: A many-coloured animal-like silhouette crosses a luminous blue ground.
works.alt: A rainbow-coloured animal-like figure in profile within a gold-edged blue rectangle.

works.title: A gentle impossibility
works.description: A blue, antlered form stands against green and yellow.
works.alt: An elongated blue animal-like figure with branching antlers against luminous green and yellow.

works.title: Wave inside a frame
works.description: A single curving blue-green form gathers against a warm field.
works.alt: A blue and green curling wave-like shape inside an orange-red framed field.

works.title: Branching blue
works.description: An open yellow centre branches through a textured blue field.
works.alt: Branching yellow and pale lines with small coloured marks inside deep blue organic shapes.

works.title: Contour / orbit
works.description: Orange lines and pale circular centres gather on blue.
works.alt: Orange and yellow layered contours and circular shapes on a blue horizontal composition.

works.title: Angles at play
works.description: Long coloured beams cross a restless blue field.
works.alt: Angular yellow, orange and red beams crossing a blue field with pale green accents.

works.title: Routes / returns
works.description: Fine, warm lines curve and intersect through blue.
works.alt: Closely spaced yellow-orange lines, curves and branching junctions against blue.

works.title: One quiet line
works.description: A narrow dark form divides a restrained pale field.
works.alt: A narrow black spire-like vertical line within a black-edged pale grey square.
